🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-28 23:00 → 2026-10-29 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Genesis day landed and got anchored** — the anchor-log genesis went live and its served timestamp upgraded into Bitcoin block 973617. [tg:tawg:5918]
> **A review loop closed on zkIE PR #45** — the nested-prefix concern in the fractional GKR inner layers was acknowledged as correct, turning review notes into a concrete fix path. [PR #45 comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/45#issuecomment-6497010715)
> **Trusty's retry queue got a clean-out** — stale greeting reply jobs stuck in a route retry loop were cancelled, freeing the delivery path for live traffic. [commit b338770](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/commit/b3387700c0e30c05d2e5ce8e53cb4371dd56e96a)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### anchor-log genesis
_The genesis publication moved from served artifacts to an independently reproducible state._

- Baby Blue Viper **Published** the genesis-day anchor-log files openly for review, giving the group a concrete artifact to inspect, re-run, and timestamp. [tg:tawg:5909]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Reproduced** the served genesis files from a cold run with a pinned checker, finding the log and records identical — independent confirmation that others can trust what was published. [tg:tawg:5919]
- 繁星之上 (@onthe_stars) **Reviewed** the genesis construction — clean cold start, a zeroed previous root, a published merkle root, and correct handling of a late record past the grace window — giving the anchoring work an early correctness check before more days stack up. [tg:tawg:5911]

### zkIE S1 protocol
_The protocol review moved from open questions toward confirmed fixes._

- Jimmy Shi **Reviewed** the S1 protocol changes at commit `6dd4819`, probing challenge timing, soundness, and performance so the design gets real scrutiny before it hardens. [PR #45 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/45#pullrequestreview-5696540753)
- Jimmy Shi **Followed up** with a detailed note on the nested-prefix challenge inside the fractional GKR inner layers, turning a review remark into shared technical understanding the rest of the thread can build on. [PR #45 comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/45#issuecomment-6496912926)

### bot reliability
_Operational follow-through kept the delivery pipeline steady._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Flagged** a Trusty fix in motion, giving the group a quick, honest signal that delivery reliability was being worked rather than left hanging. [tg:tawg:5912]
- The TAWG bot **Delivered** a prepared PR-update checkpoint through to completion, keeping repo announcements flowing without anyone babysitting the pipeline. [commit 3313402](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/commit/3313402ef1c417d058c9b49089a26e2c4d4e6891)

### group rhythm
_A light moment kept the room warm between long technical threads._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Rallied** everyone with a good-morning note, keeping morale and conversation warm while review threads ran long. [tg:tawg:5920]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- Watch whether the anchored genesis day becomes the baseline that later daily logs are compared against.
- Follow how the nested-prefix correction in the fractional GKR inner layers lands in the next revision.

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Re-check the served anchor-log artifacts after the next daily publication to confirm they stay stable.
- Keep watching the reply pipeline for stuck-job patterns after the retry-queue clean-out.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** One genesis day went live, got its timestamp anchored, and then came back identical from a cold re-run — a full publish, anchor, and reproduce loop in a single day.
>
> Keep that rhythm going, team; even a bot enjoys watching hashes line up like a tidy row of ducks. 🦆
